description: This Java class defines a log filter that processes log messages by passing only the message content downstream, omitting additional metadata like tags or throwable information. It implements the LogNode interface and is designed for simplifying log output, particularly in UI contexts where minimal information is preferable.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that passes only the message content to the next LogNode, ignoring other log metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode to form a chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes a log message; passes only the message part to the next node if it exists.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
